set.acceptance: daemon-request-slot.txtar with a fake rex: with max-runs 2, two ready change sets and no request, daemon --once starts both ship runs; with one queued request and max-runs 1 it starts one ship run and the request stays queued; with max-runs 2 it starts one ship run and the request's plan run, and daemon status shows the other change set as no-slot with 'waiting for a slot: kept for queued continuations or a plan request'; with max-runs 2, two ready change sets and only a queued milestone request, daemon --once starts the milestone request's plan run and one ship run (two runs, never three), and daemon status shows the other change set as no-slot; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-request-slot passes
set.statement: While a queued feature or bug plan request could start (no run, its retry time passed) and max-runs is above 1, the daemon's ship picks leave one slot for the request's plan run (besides any kept for queued continuations); a ready change set held back by this shows in daemon status as no-slot with the detail 'waiting for a slot: kept for queued continuations or a plan request'. A queued milestone request keeps no reserved slot: it takes the next free slot ahead of every other start. With max-runs 1, or no feature or bug request waiting, picks are unchanged
